ChangeNotes.Value:
v3.6.0 - Their minds in your hands: rewrite who they are and what they remember of you, right in the game.
YOURS TO REWRITE * "Their prompt" on the talk screen has two new tabs: Who they are (rewrite who a character is; save it empty to have the game describe them again) and Deep memory (fix or add to what they remember of you) * More of the prompt is yours to reword in the new prompts.txt: the deep memory's own words and how backstories are framed. Delete an entry to bring back the shipped words
MODELS * The Claude plan road offers the newest models: Haiku 5.5 (the new default), Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1
FIXES * A child's feast closed in a place too poor for it (a camp, a ship) is asked again in a worthier place * Newborns no longer show up in the letters list
EXPERIMENTAL * Off by default: at sea, the talk screen can show them on a ship's deck (EnableSeaStage in config.json). It can crash on some setups; if it does, it switches itself off
